Maya: Heads-up — Voyager POC kickoff request. Two-week scope: invoice extraction + context-aware QA. Need prompt inventory, pass criteria, quick hosted vs dedicated estimate. Who can own?
Arjun: I can lead prompts + eval. Quick Q: do they require on-prem or will hosted suffice for pilot?
Leah: Customer prefers hosted for speed but asked about KMS and 30-day retention. Also they want a short line for the security questionnaire about data handling.
Carlos: Suggested pass criteria draft:
- Extraction: >=95% field F1 on their 40-sample holdout
- QA: >=85% helpfulness on 80 queries, <5% hallucination in spot checks
- Latency: demo p95 <300ms hosted, <200ms dedicated
Arjun: Initial prompt inventory (short):
- extract/invoice_json_v1 — JSON extractor prompt for OCR text
- extract/normalize_money_v1 — currency/decimal normalizer
- qa/system_cite_v1 — system prompt: cite context paragraph ids, say "I don't know" if unsure
- qa/safety_v1 — fallback to request docs, refuse speculation
Maya: Timeline idea — Day 0 kickoff, Day 1-3 prompt baseline + infra, Day 4-8 extraction evals, Day 9-11 QA integration, Day 12 buffer, Day 13 demo prep, Day 14 demo.
Leah: Pricing blurb: hosted ~ $1k for 2-week pilot (small models + batching); dedicated needs sizing call — ballpark $4k/mo min.
Arjun: I'll push prompts/ and evals/ to the skeleton repo by EOD Day 1. Leah, can you draft the security blurb for the questionnaire?
Leah: On it. Short paragraph on KMS, retention, and no-training policy. Share by EOD.
ops-bot: [info] Demo slot booked 2024-06-10T14:00Z on sandbox-demo-3.
Maya: Great. Action owners: Arjun prompts + evals, Leah security blurb, Carlos owns pass/fail report. We'll sync Day 3. :thumbsup:
